title: Print an integer
explanation:
printf uses a format string to decide how to display a value.
Use %d for an int and \n to end the output line.

questions.prompt: Which line prints the integer score?
questions.hint: Think about the format specifier for a decimal integer.

options.feedback: %d prints the int as a decimal number.
The string prints the word score.

questions.prompt: Which line prints the character grade?
questions.hint: Each type has its own format specifier. Which one is for a single character?

options.feedback: %c prints the char as a character, A.
%s expects a string, not a single char.
